title: FY27_PKB_SFS Range Cleaning (Sources Sought)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR COMBAT COMMAND > FA4809  4TH CONS SQ CC
description:
The 4th Contracting Squadron at Seymour Johnson Air Force Base is conducting market research for a Combat Arms Training and Maintenance (CATM) range-cleaning requirement in accordance with the attached draft Statement of Work (SOW). 

 Interested and capable firms are requested to submit a capability statement no later than the deadline identified in this notice. The capability statement should address the firm’s ability to perform the requirements identified in the draft SOW. 

 The Government anticipates a period of performance consisting of a 12-month base period and four 12-month option periods.
